summary.en: A pure-JavaScript remake of the Atari classic, with vector-line graphics and real inertia physics.
summary.zh: 纯 JS 复刻雅达利经典《Asteroids》，矢量线条画风，含惯性物理。

description.en: Thrust, rotate and fire to shatter asteroids into smaller and smaller fragments. Momentum carries you the whole time — one careless drift ends the run.
description.zh: 推进、转向、射击击碎小行星，大石分裂成小石；撞上碎片或飞出屏幕边界循环回来时被撞即结束。

howto.en: Arrow keys to rotate and thrust, space to shoot.

tip.en: The inertia-heavy shooting feel is genuinely good and outlasts your average shooter. The repo has no ready-made demo — just clone and deploy statically, a one-minute job.
tip.zh: 射击手感（惯性漂移）做得好，比一般打飞机耐玩。仓库没有现成在线 demo，需要自己 clone 后静态部署，一分钟的事。
